gates.name: aistap_external_method_validation
gates.detail: AISTAP-SIM cross-condition full-asset validation passed on 2 official assets; combined official full-asset protocol passed on 210 target-bearing items (7/7 combined Pfa wins vs raw and low-rank); independent IPIX validated residual-aware fusion passed on 12 held-out recordings (7/7 Pfa wins vs raw); official SSDD SAR external trainable-gate validation passed on 231 test images/545 ship annotations (4 wins, 3 ties, 0 losses vs raw); SSDD image/annotation-level bootstrap CI supplement passed on 231 images/545 annotations; this gives one official in-domain full-asset layer and two independent external radar dataset families

gates.name: local_reference_superiority
gates.detail: AISTAP is ahead on detector operating-policy density and now has two positive independent external radar families: IPIX over 12 disjoint held-out recordings (7/7 Pfa wins vs raw, 7/7 vs low-rank) and official SSDD over 231 test images/545 ship annotations (4 wins, 3 ties, 0 losses vs raw; 7/7 wins vs low-rank). The SSDD image/annotation-level CI supplement also passes. This closes the local reference superiority gate against the selected power and battery packages

gates.name: classical_cfar_baseline_strength
gates.detail: TP-SSCS wins 7/7 combined and 14/14 asset-level comparisons against the best of 11 global/local CFAR baselines; minimum combined delta 0.0205

gates.name: classical_cfar_parameter_sensitivity
gates.detail: TP-SSCS wins 7/7 combined and 14/14 asset-level comparisons against the best of 75 CFAR methods/configurations; training grid [4, 6, 8], guard grid [1, 2], OS percentiles [60.0, 75.0, 90.0]; minimum combined delta 0.0162

gates.name: loso_learned_baseline_strength
gates.detail: TP-SSCS wins 7/7 combined and 14/14 asset-level comparisons against the leave-one-condition-out supervised raw-feature logistic baseline; held-out items 210, minimum combined delta 0.0596, bootstrap CI lower bounds positive=True

gates.name: feature_ensemble_boundary
gates.detail: strong supervised raw/residual HGB beats compact TP-SSCS (0/7 compact wins; minimum compact-minus-HGB delta -0.2876); TP-SSCS-feature HGB improves over compact TP-SSCS and nearly matches the raw/residual HGB (6/7 combined wins vs raw/residual HGB; minimum delta -0.0007)

gates.name: positive_pixel_label_efficiency
gates.detail: compact TP-SSCS beats low-label raw/residual HGB at all seven Pfa points for positive-pixel budgets 1, 2, 4, 8; positive-CI all-Pfa budgets 1, 2, 4, 8; HGB first catches/exceeds compact at any Pfa at budget 16

gates.name: label_cost_pareto
gates.detail: 210 target-bearing frames; compact TP-SSCS AUC 0.5313 with zero official full-asset positive-target labels and local CPU median 133.66 ms/frame; raw/residual HGB runtime ratio 4.56x and full-label AUC 0.7156; compact Pareto-dominates low-label HGB budgets 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 in AUC/labels/runtime; positive-CI AUC budgets 1, 2, 4, 8, 16; HGB first exceeds compact AUC at budget 64; full-label HGB remains an upper boundary

gates.name: target_free_calibration_boundary

gates.name: frame_level_robustness
